problem: Read a CSV file, group data by a specified 'category' column, calculate the mean of a 'value' column for each group, and then visualize the results as a bar chart.

data_requirements.name: csv_file_path
data_requirements.description: The file path to the input CSV data. The CSV is expected to contain 'category' and 'value' columns.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries: pandas for data manipulation and matplotlib.pyplot for plotting.
Load the CSV file from the specified 'csv_file_path' into a pandas DataFrame.
Group the DataFrame by the 'category' column and calculate the mean of the 'value' column for each category. Store the result in a new DataFrame or Series.
Prepare the aggregated data for plotting. This might involve resetting the index of the grouped result to make 'category' a regular column if it became an index during grouping.
Create a bar chart using matplotlib.pyplot. The 'category' column will be used for the x-axis and the calculated mean 'value' for the y-axis.
Add appropriate labels to the x-axis ('Category'), y-axis ('Mean Value'), and a title to the chart ('Mean Value by Category').

notes: Assumes the CSV file exists at the given path and contains columns named 'category' and 'value'. Error handling for file not found or missing columns should be considered during implementation. The 'value' column is assumed to contain numerical data suitable for mean calculation.
